verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm that provides attorney-led petition drafting, filing, and compliance services. Issuing scoped API credentials to agents is a software-platform capability outside this kind of product. The only technology mentioned is a client document and communication portal, and probes found no OpenAPI or API surface that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
